Negotiators are extending their stay as the summit risks ending without a consensus, a rare occurrence in the history of these meetings.

brief.why: Disagreements persist because the EU refuses to support a deal that 'greenwashes' fossil fuels, while developing nations argue that developed countries must provide financial support for climate adaptation. Saudi Arabia and other petro-states have resisted language targeting oil, gas, and coal.
brief.next: Negotiating teams are delaying their departures to Monday to continue discussions, though the summit may be suspended and reconvened next year if no consensus is reached.

items.title: BepiColombo reaches Mercury orbit after nearly eight years in space
items.author: Gabriele Petrauskaite
items.summary: The BepiColombo spacecraft has successfully entered orbit around Mercury after an eight-year journey. The joint mission will soon separate into two orbiters to conduct simultaneous scientific observations of the planet.

also.author: Davide Castelvecchi
also.title: BepiColombo finally reaches Mercury after eight-year odyssey
also.note: Nature frames the story as an 'odyssey,' emphasizing the long duration of the mission compared to the more technical focus of the AeroTime report.

brief.what: The BepiColombo mission, a collaboration between the European Space Agency and the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency, has successfully achieved orbital capture around Mercury. The spacecraft stack, consisting of the Mercury Planetary Orbiter and the Mio orbiter, entered an initial elliptical polar orbit measuring 590 by 11,640 kilometres after firing four thrusters to reduce speed.
brief.who: The European Space Agency and the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency are the primary mission operators.
brief.context: BepiColombo is the second mission to orbit Mercury, following NASA's MESSENGER spacecraft. It is designed to provide simultaneous observations from two different spacecraft to study the planet's surface, internal structure, and magnetic environment.
brief.why: The mission aims to help scientists better understand Mercury’s formation, evolution, and unusual magnetic environment through complementary measurements taken from different orbital altitudes.
brief.next: The two orbiters are scheduled to separate in December 2026, with scientific operations expected to commence in April 2027.

items.title: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic’s second day of trading
items.author: Lauren Almeida and Graeme Wearden
items.summary: The Nasdaq erased its 2026 gains as a broader AI sell-off dampened the second day of trading for Anthropic, the maker of the Claude chatbot. Investors are increasingly questioning the sustainability of massive capital expenditures in the AI sector.

brief.what: The Nasdaq Composite wiped out its 2026 gains, closing down 5% for the year, as a global sell-off hit AI-linked stocks. Anthropic’s shares fell 9% to $88.30 on their second day of trading, failing to sustain the momentum of its record-breaking IPO.
brief.who: Anthropic, the developer of the Claude chatbot, is the central firm in the market volatility, alongside major tech companies like Nvidia, SanDisk, and Micron, which also saw significant share price declines.
brief.context: Investors are shifting from a 'buy the dip' mentality to questioning whether the massive investments in AI infrastructure can deliver necessary returns. This sentiment is compounded by concerns over elevated valuations and potential interest rate hikes by US central bankers.
brief.why: Analysts suggest Anthropic may be draining market liquidity as investors sell other holdings to fund AI-related purchases. Daniela Hathorn of Capital.com notes that while demand for AI exposure remains, concerns regarding profitability and sustainability are driving the broader market correction.

items.title: Nobody wanted him, now Trump wants to be him: The ‘I Play Rocky’ movie rocked
items.author: Rusty Wright
items.summary: The enduring cultural influence of the Rocky film franchise is highlighted through its impact on political figures and public imagery. The article explores how Sylvester Stallone’s underdog narrative continues to resonate in modern political discourse.

brief.what: The Rocky film franchise remains a significant cultural touchstone, frequently utilized by politicians at rallies and in digital media. President Donald Trump recently shared a photoshopped meme depicting himself with the physique and championship attire of the Rocky character.
brief.who: Sylvester Stallone, the creator and star of the Rocky films, and President Donald Trump, who utilized Rocky-themed imagery in his political messaging.
brief.context: For decades, the Rocky series has served as a symbol of the underdog story, influencing various sectors of society including athletics and politics. The song "Eye of the Tiger" from Rocky III is a common fixture at political campaign events.
brief.why: The imagery is used because the Rocky character serves as a powerful, recognizable symbol of perseverance and success that resonates with the public and political figures alike.
